output.explanation: The create order call to POST /v2/checkout/orders went out without a PayPal-Request-Id header, so if the response was lost and the request was retried, PayPal would create a second order instead of returning the first. createOrder now sends a PayPal-Request-Id that is a fresh crypto.randomUUID() for each checkout attempt. It also takes an optional requestId argument, so a caller that retries the same attempt can pass the same id and get the original order back. The existing call in server.js keeps working unchanged.
